threshold_rules: Current default: top-1 hit relevance == 'high' AND no retrieval (search/show/list) in the lookback window.
v1 + top-1 score >= 50.0. Filters single-token high-relevance hits that score only on coverage.
v1 + top-1 score >= 2x top-2 score. Distinguishes one-clear-match from borderline-ranker-noise.
Intersection of v2 and v3: must clear both the score floor and the dominance test.
widening_rules: Top-1 shadow relevance_v2 == 'high' (coverage >= 0.75 OR matched_unique >= 4) AND no retrieval in window.
v1 high, OR top-1 promoted medium→high by the shadow matched-token floor. Excludes w1's low→high promotions (measured ~20% precision on the 2026-07-08 labeling pass vs ~50% for medium→high).
